items.title: Understand the setting of the story
items.explanation: The story takes place in a jungle near a railway line. The train tracks are described as 'two straight black serpents disappearing into the tunnel in the hillside.' The environment is characterized by tall evergreen trees, scrub-covered hills, and a dark tunnel where heat waves shimmer along the embankment.

items.title: Identify key vocabulary
items.explanation: Key terms include 'shimmered' (appears to move), 'cutting' (a narrow valley cut through a hill), 'flinch' (make a quick movement), and 'plume of smoke' (long, thin cloud of smoke). These words help describe the heat, the train's path, and the visual effects inside the tunnel.
